# Consolidated implementation history

This index replaces the per-task plan files 001–040 to keep the repository
context compact. The work was implemented, incorporated into later work, or
superseded. Original plan details remain available in Git history.

The original files had some stale or incomplete status and manual-check markers;
this list is historical, not an open-work queue. Use
[`current-state.md`](./current-state.md), [`screens.md`](./screens.md), and
[`gaps.md`](./gaps.md) for what is true now.
